# Interactive Dashboards {.unnumbered}

## Overview

Static PDF reports often sit unread, so this chapter introduces dynamic Knowledge Translation through Shiny apps and dashboards. Students will take their prior EDA results and transform them into interactive web tools that allow users to filter and explore the data themselves. You will learn the best practices of user interface design for health data and deploy your first live dashboard to the web via GitHub Pages or Shinylive.

## Connection

Week 7 established an auditable descriptive foundation. This week is the first app-forward week: students run the NHANES dashboard, identify an audience, and improve one audience-facing element. Next week turns one dashboard finding into a short scientific communication product.

## In-Class Activity

- Run the app and describe the intended audience in one sentence.
- Make one audience-facing improvement to a label, help text, or interpretation note.
- Verify the app still loads the cached RDS after your change.
- Write one limitation statement that belongs inside or beside the dashboard.

Student output: a local app run note, one audience-facing text improvement, and a limitation statement. Assignment link: `../../assignments/assignment07-dashboard/README.md`.

## Definition of Done

- Students can produce a small dashboard-style KT artifact from prior EDA outputs.
- The dashboard runs or renders in the supported workflow.
- The page distinguishes required core work from optional deployment extensions.
